en: Last riddle: three tablets, one every half hour, starting right now. How many minutes?
The first tablet is taken right now, at zero minutes.
The second at thirty minutes, and the third at sixty. Only two gaps! The answer is sixty minutes!
Person one has seventeen sheep on a farm.
One stormy night, all but nine of them run away.
Person two says: eight are left. Person three says: no way!
So, how many sheep does Person one have now?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
